CALL TO ORDER

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that
are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2,
the Parklands Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any
item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency
nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  JANUARY 9, 2012

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  January 9, 2012
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Members present: Chair Peterson, Shaffer, Chooljian,
  Schoenheider and Rubincam

  Members absent: None

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

None

CITIZEN APPLICATIONS

1.  PC-337-11; Application to remove 1 Coral tree located in the parkway adjacent to
  541 Palos Verdes Drive West

  Applicant:  Barbara Thorne
  541 Palos Verdes Drive West
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Approved (4-1, Chooljian dissenting). The applicant is approved to remove
1 coral tree located in the parkway adjacent to 541 Palos Verdes Drive West
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’ and to plant 1
‘Designated Street Tree’.

Parklands Committee
Action Memo
January 9, 2012  Director_______________
 2.  PC-338-11; Application to remove 1 Canary Island pine tree located in the
  parkway adjacent to 1733 Via Boronada

  Applicant:  Ron and Kari Rothstein
  1728 Via Boronado
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Approved (5-0). The applicant is approved to remove 1 Canary Island pine
tree located in the parkway adjacent to 1733 Via Boronada according to the
‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’. The applicant has the option to
replace the tree with the ‘Designated Street Tree’, a Coppertone Loquat or pay a
non-refundable $500 to the ‘Tree Bank’.

OLD BUSINESS

3.  Policy for private landscaping of Parklands

Continued to the following Parklands Committee meeting.

None

None

Action: Approved (5-0) as written.

ADJOURNMENT

Adjourned to February 13, 2012.
